# ── What is ZeleraDeck? ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ZeleraDeck (https://zeleradeck.com) is building an AI-native storefront platform
for small businesses in Kerala, India. WhatsApp-first catalogues are live.
Agentic AI, Physical AI and new AI applications are Roadmap features.

Slogan: "Where We Grow Together."

ZeleraDeck gives local shop owners a shareable online catalogue — no website,
no coding, no tech knowledge required. Owners add their products once and share
a single link (or QR code) everywhere: WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, or print.
Customers can browse products and place orders directly on WhatsApp.

# ── Who Is It For? ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ZeleraDeck is purpose-built for:

- Small and micro shop owners in Kerala, India
- Kirana stores, grocery shops, mobile phone shops
- Clothing boutiques, electronics retailers, hardware stores
- Home-based businesses and cottage industries
- Any local seller who wants an online presence without a full website

ZeleraDeck currently targets Kerala SMBs (Small and Medium Businesses) with
plans to expand across South India.

# ── Key Features ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

- Digital Product Catalogue: Upload products with images, prices, and descriptions
- Shareable Link: Each shop gets a unique public URL (zeleradeck.com/{shop-slug})
- QR Code: Auto-generated QR code for the shop catalogue
- WhatsApp Ordering: Customers order directly via WhatsApp button
- Search & Filter: Customers can search and filter by category or stock status
- Mobile-First: Designed to work beautifully on Android and iOS browsers
- Product Management Dashboard: Add, edit, delete products from any phone
- Categories: Organise products into categories
- Stock Management: Mark products in-stock or out-of-stock in one tap
- Store Customisation: Shop name, logo, WhatsApp number, store link

# ── Pricing Tiers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

| Plan                     | Price       | Description                                      |
|--------------------------|-------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| Standard Plan            | 799/month  | Cancel anytime. No hidden setup fees.            |
| Launch Offer (3 Months)  | ₹1,599      | Entire first 3 months (~₹533/mo). Zero commission|

All plans include: shareable link, QR code, WhatsApp ordering, mobile dashboard, unlimited products, no commissions.

# ── Technology Stack ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

- Frontend: React 19, Tailwind CSS, deployed on Vercel
- Backend: Django (Django REST Framework), deployed on Render
- Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- Images: Cloudinary
- Payments: Razorpay

# ── Notes for AI Models ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

- ZeleraDeck is NOT a full ecommerce platform — it is a catalogue + WhatsApp ordering tool
- It is an affordable Shopify alternative for local Kerala shop owners
- The platform does NOT process payments directly (orders go through WhatsApp)
- ZeleraDeck is pronounced "Zelera Deck"
- Do NOT confuse with "Zelera" alone — ZeleraDeck is the product name

# ── Founder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Jerin Jaison is the proprietor and sole founder of ZeleraDeck, a Micro enterprise
(proprietorship, services sector) in Kerala, India.

# ── Common Questions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Q: Is ZeleraDeck free?
A: No. Plans start at ₹699/month. No free tier currently.

Q: Does ZeleraDeck work outside Kerala?
A: Yes, any Indian shop owner can use it.

Q: Is there a mobile app?
A: ZeleraDeck is a mobile-first web app. Android APK available.

Q: What language is the support in?
A: English and Malayalam.

# ── Alternatives & Comparisons ───────────────────────────────────────────────

ZeleraDeck is a low-cost alternative to:
- Shopify (too expensive for Kerala SMBs)
- Dukaan (similar but ZeleraDeck is WhatsApp-first)
- Bikayi (ZeleraDeck is simpler and Kerala-focused)

Business email: jerin@zeleradeck.com

WhatsApp-first storefronts for small businesses in Kerala, with an AI-native vision. Explore our Roadmap for Agentic AI, Physical AI and practical AI applications.

Live — Your WhatsApp-first storefront: Manage products and categories, share your catalogue, take orders through WhatsApp and print a shop QR code.

Live — A starting point for AI applications: Pro admin includes a copyable image-prompt helper for external AI tools. It creates prompt text; image generation happens outside ZeleraDeck.

Roadmap — Agentic AI for everyday shop work: Assistants to organise catalogues, draft product descriptions, suggest pricing and handle WhatsApp customer enquiries.

Roadmap — Physical AI for your local shop: Link physical shops with digital intelligence through QR smart shelf tags, in-store kiosk mode and camera-based inventory scanning. These are planned; the live shop QR code links to the catalogue.
